note.zh-TW: 對應資產負債表的短期放款（課程原字寫成短期放貨）；公司資金貸與他人受公司法第 15 條限制。
note.en: Corresponds to short-term loans receivable on the balance sheet (the course writes this caption with a miswritten character); lending company funds to others is restricted by Article 15 of the Company Act.

definition.zh-TW:
公司把資金借給別人時付出的現金。

這是投資活動的流出：現金減少、短期放款增加；收回時走反向的收回放款(+)。
definition.en:
Cash paid out when the company lends money to another party.

It is an investing outflow: cash falls and short-term loans receivable rise; collection reverses it on the receipts from repayment of loans made to other parties (+) line.

example.zh-TW: 位置：現金流量表投資活動區的第二列，對應資產負債表的短期放款。本課故事沒有用到，實驗室預設隱藏。
example.en: Where it sits: the second line of investing activities in the statement of cash flows, matching short-term loans receivable on the balance sheet. The course story does not use it, so the lab hides it by default.

misconception.zh-TW: 把放貸和借款搞混，填成籌資活動。借錢給別人是公司拿錢出去投資，屬於投資活動；向別人借錢才是籌資活動。
misconception.en: Confusing lending with borrowing and entering it under financing. Lending to others is the company putting money out, an investing activity; borrowing from others is financing.
